022PXX22.XX22.160504104251.Y4Y7.name: Rinku Vishwakarma
022PXX22.XX22.160504104251.Y4Y7.review: The bohris are typical gujarati Muslims who make ah-mazinnggg non veg food. I actually was watching the owner in fox life channel`s show grill kitchen. Since that I wanted to visit his place. This place is actually a house were they serve beautiful huge thal of food made by his mom. So I had there mutton khema smoked samosa which was so so awesome. Then I had boneless chicken biriyani which was yummmmmm. I had so much fun over that place. For some dishes which you want to have parcel must order a day before for the preparation. They serve paya soup with biriyani and raita which was pretty good.

pop_random.review: Had a wonderful Saturday night dinner, special thank you to Kadir, The Chief Tasting Officer. The delivery was spot on-time, the packaging worth every penny (as you can see in the picture). The food was worth the wait. I have visited Munafs house for the sit down experience. Was missing that and after the dinner last night it brought back all the memories. Loved the biryani and the non veg platter was gone in no time. Amazing baida roti and the Russian cutlets my favourite. Will be looking at ordering again and thank you for delivering all over Mumbai, it`s such a blessing!
